# Daily report: Saturday, November 28, 2026

**Health:** The runner is running, every bot's books match the Alpaca paper account, no bots are stuck, and there were no errors.

**Fake money:** 73 live bots hold $72,654 together, down from $73,000 at the start. Bots running 24 hours ago lost $473 today (-0.7%), mostly because crypto fell. Stock galaxies were slightly up.

## Galaxies (average change of their bots)

| Galaxy | Avg change |
|---|---|
| S&P 500, Small Companies | +0.3% |
| Nvidia, Gold | +0.2% |
| Nasdaq-100, Apple, Dow Jones | +0.1% |
| Coin Breakout Portfolio | 0.0% (in cash) |
| Treasury Bonds, Tesla | -0.1% or less |
| Chainlink, Dogecoin, Solana | -0.2% to -0.3% |
| XRP | -0.6% |
| Bitcoin | -0.9% |
| Ethereum | -1.0% |
| Avalanche | -1.7% |

## Top and bottom bots

"Buy & Hold" means buying once and keeping it. Each bot is compared with its galaxy's Buy & Hold.

**Top 5 (all beat Buy & Hold):** Ethereum v3 · Daily Trend, v6 · 20-Day Breakout and v9 · Swing: 20-Day Breakout (0.0%, in cash, +3.7 points), Avalanche v2 · 20-Day Breakout (0.0%, +3.3), Ethereum v7 · Grid Bot (-1.7%, +2.0).

**Bottom 5 (all trail Buy & Hold):** Bitcoin v21 · 15-Min ICT Fair Value Gap (-4.4%, 2.8 points behind), and S&P 500 v2, v4, v6 and v7 (0.0%, 1.9 behind each). The S&P bots only trail because they waited in cash while stocks rose.

## Shadow league

Shadow bots follow live prices with pretend books and never place orders. EMA 12/26 trend and 20-day breakout each beat Buy & Hold on 10 of 39 assets; 90-day momentum, 200-day guard and daily trend on 9; golden cross on 6. Two days of data means nothing yet.

## Trades in the last 24 hours: 27

- The stock Buy & Hold bots bought their first shares at Friday's early close.
- Bitcoin v21 · ICT Fair Value Gap made 3 more quick trades, each a small loss: 12 trades, no wins, $28.61 in fees, as its backtest (a test on past prices) warned.
- Bitcoin v2 · Hourly Trend, v12 · 4-Hour MACD and the coin flip sold.
- Bitcoin v3 and v4 · 4-Hour Trend bought back in this morning.

## Lab notes

- The two queued ideas (swing breakout on every coin, "3 down days" swing on every stock fund) skipped their tests again because another heavy program was open. They'll run later.
- No bots added, promoted or retired. The oldest bot is 2 days old; the rules want 30+ days first.
- Scorecard: every strategy is "Too early". "Real-use candidate" needs 90+ days live, so none is close.

*Reminder: this is all fake money, and results from the first few months are mostly luck.*

# Daily report: Thursday, November 26, 2026

**Health:** All good. The runner is running, every bot's record matches the practice account, no bots are stuck, and there were no errors (just planned restarts and one unfilled test order).

**Fake money:** The 65 live bots hold **$64,996.64**, down $3.37 from $65,000 (about 0.0%). Every bot is under a day old. US stock markets are closed for Thanksgiving.

| All stock galaxies + Coin Breakout Portfolio | 1-11 each | 0.00% |

## Top 5 and bottom 5 bots

"Buy & Hold" (just buying and keeping) is the yardstick every bot must beat.

- **Top:** Bitcoin v2 · Hourly Trend +0.2% (behind Buy & Hold); Avalanche v2 · 20-Day Breakout 0.0% (beat it by staying in cash); Coin Breakout Portfolio · Avalanche slice 0.0% (beat it); Ethereum v2 · 4-Hour Trend and Ethereum v3 · Daily Trend 0.0% (both beat it, barely).
- **Bottom:** Ethereum v8 · 15-Min ICT Fair Value Gap -1.7%; Bitcoin v21 · 15-Min ICT Fair Value Gap -0.2%; Bitcoin v17 · Grid Bot -0.2%; Bitcoin v19 · 50/50 Rebalance -0.1%; Bitcoin v13 · Golden Cross -0.1%. All five are behind Buy & Hold.

## Shadow league

Shadow bots are pretend bots that follow real prices but never place orders (273 on 39 assets). The daily trend, 200-day guard, 20-day breakout and EMA 12/26 rules each beat Buy & Hold on 13 of 39 assets. That's after less than a day, so it means nothing yet.

## Trades

21 trades so far, mostly first buys. Highlights:
- Ethereum v8 (ICT) bought at $1,705.76, sold at $1,675.70 (-1.8%), then bought again. That's the fast, fee-heavy trading our tests warned about.
- The Bitcoin and Ethereum grid bots each bought half their slices.
- Bitcoin v2 · Hourly Trend bought and is up slightly.

## Lab notes

- Two new ideas were tested on years of past prices. Both **failed**, because an idea has to win on at least 40% of assets:
  - 12-month momentum won on 7 of 38 assets.
  - The 20-day breakout with a slower exit won on 8 of 33. It did well on coins and badly on funds.
- No bots were added, promoted or retired. Promoting or retiring a bot takes 60+ days of data.
- **Real-use candidate:** no strategy is close yet. It takes 90+ days of beating Buy & Hold.

*Results from the first few months are mostly luck. This is practice trading with fake money.*
